description: This script handles device configuration retrieval and communication with a server for web configuration purposes. It manages certificates, generates UUIDs, and performs HTTP requests with retries.

methods.name: getCpgConfig
methods.description: Fetches static CPG configuration if available

methods.name: getDeviceConfigFile
methods.description: Retrieves device configuration, handles certificates, and prepares data for server request

methods.name: runcURL
methods.description: Performs HTTP request to server with device info and handles retries
